desc: Language of the web that also powers scripts, tooling, and Node.js services.

sections.title: Setup
sections.description: Check the runtime, run a file, and evaluate a one-liner.

snippets.code:
# Check the installed runtime and package manager
node --version            # v22.11.0
npm --version             # 10.9.0

# Run a script once, then rerun it on every save
node app.js
node --watch app.js

# Evaluate an expression without creating a file
node -e "console.log(2 ** 10)"   # 1024

sections.title: Types
sections.description: Primitive values, typeof results, and numeric edge cases.

snippets.code:
// The primitive types are string, number, bigint, boolean,
// undefined, null and symbol
console.log(typeof "text");          // "string"
console.log(typeof 42);              // "number"
console.log(typeof 42n);             // "bigint"
console.log(typeof true);            // "boolean"
console.log(typeof undefined);       // "undefined"
console.log(typeof Symbol("id"));    // "symbol"

// Objects and the historical null quirk
console.log(typeof null);            // "object"
console.log(typeof {});              // "object"
console.log(typeof []);              // "object"
console.log(typeof function () {});  // "function"
